sources.name: FIDE Handbook - Chess Equipment with Electronic Components
FIDE TEC Policies and Procedures Manual 1.24

confirmedRequirements: A THP manages Swiss tournaments through player data, pairings and results.
FIDE mode requires an English interface/manual, current and backward TRF exchange, free embedded PTC and RTG unless exempted, and a controlled tester environment.
A successful SDPC precedes TAPC and TAPC applies only to the exact SDPC product version.
The candidate PTC processes 50000 tournaments from an external accepted RTG.
The candidate RTG generates 50000 tournaments for one or more available PTCs.
An external-engine exemption is described only for an engine already integrated into another FIDE-accepted THP and still requires TEC-visible engine inputs.
